question: A solution to the system of equations $ax+by+cz=0$ and $a^2x+b^2y+c^2z=0$ is

options.B: $x=\frac{k(b-c)}{a^2},\ y=\frac{k(c-a)}{b^2},\ z=\frac{k(a-b)}{c^2}$, where $k$ is an arbitrary constant
options.D: $x=\frac{k(b-c)}a,\ y=\frac{k(c-a)}b,\ z=\frac{k(a-b)}c$, where $k$ is an arbitrary constant

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
